documents.title: upload incident
documents.body: Upload batch failed with HTTP 429 Too Many Requests. The gateway rejected requests when sixteen workers uploaded concurrently. Retrying immediately exhausted the quota again.

documents.title: upload decision
documents.body: After the upload throttling failure we capped the upload pool at three concurrent workers and honored Retry-After. The previous unrestricted fan-out was rejected.

documents.title: credentials incident
documents.body: Upload requests failed with HTTP 401 Unauthorized because the access token had expired. We refreshed the credentials. Request concurrency was unchanged.

documents.title: database delay
documents.body: The payment handler spent 1800 milliseconds waiting to acquire a database connection. The connection pool was exhausted by long-running transactions; query execution itself took 12 milliseconds.

documents.title: pool decision
documents.body: We shortened the payment transaction to release database connections before calling the external provider. Increasing the HTTP timeout would have hidden the queueing bottleneck.

documents.title: compiler output
documents.body: error[E0382]: borrow of moved value: request. The value was moved into the spawned task before the retry branch inspected it.

documents.title: ownership decision
documents.body: We moved a cheap request identifier into the task instead of cloning the entire payload. This avoids using a moved request in the retry branch.

documents.title: configuration write
documents.body: A crash during configuration replacement left a half-written JSON file. The new implementation writes to a temporary file, flushes it, then atomically renames it over the destination.

documents.title: stale settings
documents.body: The process continued serving stale feature flags after the configuration file changed. The watcher lost an event; this did not corrupt the JSON file.

documents.title: network failure
documents.body: The TLS handshake failed because the server certificate had expired. Renewing the certificate restored secure connectivity.

documents.title: process cancellation
documents.body: Cancelling the parent request left a child command running in the background. We added explicit child termination and waited for cleanup to finish.

documents.title: migration rollback
documents.body: The database migration was rolled back after older clients failed to parse the new enum value. The compatible reader must be deployed before writing the new value.

documents.title: verification
documents.body: The retry unit test passed against a mock server. No production load test or multi-region failover test was performed.

documents.title: unrelated rate
documents.body: Audio sampling rate changed from 44.1 kHz to 48 kHz. This is unrelated to API request quotas or the upload service.

documents.title: duplicate jobs
documents.body: Two workers processed the same scheduled job after a lease expired during a long garbage collection pause. The fix renews the lease while the job is running.

documents.title: source removal
documents.body: After access to the imported conversation was revoked, the retained body and derived summaries were scrubbed. Old query cursors must request a fresh search.
